native_comparison: At least one actual production paired observation must lie inside each externally selected pixel rectangle expanded by its manual-edge plus axis-readout bounds. Negative-tail witnesses must also have Delta SNR strictly below -15 dB. No histogram half-bin allowance is applied to native observations.
histogram_comparison: Actual production chronological cells intersecting the expanded source region must have nonzero total count in both 3h and 24h profiles. Native membership is additionally required, so a coarse cell cannot provide the only witness.

assertions: OLS slope of 15 daily arithmetic means is positive
Arithmetic average of last three daily means exceeds first three
daily_mean_trend.meaning: Qualitative operationalization of the source first-half daily-average trend, not a published exact slope, significance test or monotonicity claim.

daily_mean_computation: Full-range production 24h histogram count-weighted integer-dB centres; no truncation at paper plot bounds. Pooled pairs within each UTC day; equal weighting of daily means for trend.
figure4_mean_comparison: Require the three uniquely moisture-matched UTC daily means and the first-half min/max daily means within source-only intervals. Extrema avoid ambiguous daily assignments. Figure4 maximum repeats the April15 point and is not independent evidence.
excluded_inferences: Exact medians or IQR from Figure3
Global/local statistical modes from black ink
Calibrated density ratios or counts from darkness
Exact event minimum or outlier-detector classification
Exact daily spot-count tolerance from about 2000
failure_policy: Keep source geometry and readout bounds fixed. Retain the first comparison, report a discrepancy and investigate population/time/weighting differences. Never refresh expectations from the application or widen bounds to obtain a pass.
